explanation: The 1908 route ran from Windsor Castle to the royal box in London's White City stadium: 26 miles 385 yards. That became the official marathon distance in 1921.

claims.text: The standard marathon distance of 42.195 km is the length of the course of the 1908 London Olympic marathon.
The marathon distance was not set by the Olympic courses in Athens (1896), Paris (1900) or Stockholm (1912).
The 1908 Olympic marathon started at Windsor Castle and finished in front of the royal box in the White City stadium.
42.195 km is equal to 26 miles 385 yards.
The 1908 distance of 42.195 km became the official marathon distance in 1921.
